visual.detail: Manager must inspect all views for placement, proportions, missing/extra parts and visible intersections
visual.observation: One solid annular-sector tile, 2.8 mm thick over its seated part with a 1.0 mm lapping lip along the outer end and one radial stadium key under the seat. Top: a single flat coplanar face with no dimples, rails or connectors. Both outer corners are stepped back into a bay so the tile stops short of the body at each lane boundary and the crown shows its own base there; every step is a square shoulder, not a sliver. Front: a flat strip with the key the only feature below the underside. Iso: one piece, nothing floating, missing or extra, and no visible intersection.
